hero.label: Dental studio — Ahuntsic, Montreal
hero.title: A dental clinic for those who want to understand before they decide.
hero.subtitle: At De Facto Dental Studio, every examination is taken seriously. We document, explain, prioritize and plan your care so every decision is clear, tailored and considered.

lines.1: We believe that good treatment begins with good understanding.
lines.2: That an informed patient makes better decisions.
lines.3: That prevention deserves as much attention as repair.
lines.4: That rigour is not a luxury, but a clinical responsibility.
lines.5: And that trust is built through clarity.
lines.6: De Facto is a dental studio founded on a simple idea: take the time to understand before intervening.

approche.label: Approach
approche.title: A structured, measured approach
approche.body: De Facto favours a structured approach: understand the situation, identify priorities, explain the options and plan care with measure. The goal is not to accumulate treatments, but to propose a coherent sequence, adapted to the clinical and personal reality of each patient.

triad.label: A global reading of risk
triad.title: A global reading of risk
triad.body: During the complete examination, we analyze the patient with a global lens: caries risk, periodontal health, habits, function and personal context. This reading lets us draw a fairer picture and adapt follow-up frequency, priorities and prevention.

intro.label: The Studio
intro.title: A dental studio designed to slow down, understand and plan better.
intro.body: De Facto Dental Studio was designed to offer a calmer, more structured and more personalized experience. The space, the clinical approach and the digital tools come together to create continuity between analysis, decision and treatment.

pourquoi.label: Why De Facto exists
pourquoi.title: Dr Ramdani's intention
pourquoi.body: De Facto Dental Studio grew out of Dr Ramdani's intention to create a different kind of care setting: a calm, precise and reassuring environment where the patient can be heard, understood and guided with clarity.
pourquoi.body2: The goal is not only to treat a tooth or respond to a symptom. The goal is to take the time to understand the patient's complete situation, explain what has been observed, plan care with judgment and set the right priorities.
pourquoi.body3: At De Facto, time, listening, precision and continuity are not details. They are the conditions for care that is better understood, better planned and more durable.
pourquoi.body4: The studio was designed to put the clinical relationship back at the centre of the experience: a place where technology supports the dentist's judgment without replacing it, and where every decision is made with measure.

philosophie.label: Clinical philosophy
philosophie.title: Understand before intervening
philosophie.body: Our philosophy rests on a simple idea: every treatment must fit within a global understanding of the patient. Before intervening, we seek to understand the risks, priorities, expectations and limits specific to each situation.

espace.label: The space
espace.title: A space designed to slow the pace
espace.body: The studio environment was designed to create a calmer, clearer and more human experience. Each zone — reception, clinical room, laboratory and discussion area — supports the same idea: take the time to do things well.

equipement.label: Equipment and technology
equipement.title: Technology in service of diagnosis
equipement.intro: Technology is not used as an end in itself. It serves to better diagnose, better communicate, better plan and better verify outcomes.

engagement.label: Quality commitment
engagement.title: A quality built in every decision
engagement.body: Our commitment rests on rigorous protocols, traceability of materials, the quality of clinical communications and careful review of key steps. Quality is not limited to the final result: it is built in every decision.

parcours.label: The journey in 4 phases
parcours.title: From first contact to follow-up
parcours.body: Each phase has a clear objective. The patient knows where they stand, why a recommendation is being made, and what their options are.

1.title: Before the appointment
1.body: You complete a request form, share the reason for the consultation, transmit your basic information and receive pre-visit instructions.

2.title: Complete examination
2.body: Medical questionnaire, dental history, radiographs as indicated, periodontal examination, dental examination, intraoral photos, digital scan when applicable, and discussion of your concerns.

3.title: Personalized plan
3.body: Presentation of needs, prioritization of treatments, possible options, risks of the status quo, ideal sequence, alternatives, financial estimate and coordination with insurance.

4.title: Treatment and follow-up
4.body: Delivery according to priorities, post-operative follow-up, prevention, personalized recalls and long-term maintenance.

5.title: More prevention
5.body: Identify risks before they become problems.

6.title: More transparency in the options
6.body: Clear estimates, alternatives named, shared decisions.
